preparation.title: Device preparation: jailbreak iPod touch 4
preparation.subtitle: iPod4,1 · iOS 6.1.6 (10B500) · SSH ramdisk
preparation.planFailed: The plan could not be created. Make sure the device is still connected.

overview.intro: Resources are downloaded and verified before you enter DFU. limera1n then boots an SSH ramdisk to install the Aquila 6 untether, Cydia and OpenSSH. This modifies the system without intentionally erasing data; recovery after failure may still erase all data.
overview.prerequisitesHint: Confirm each item yourself. They decide whether the flow can finish safely.
overview.dfuEntry: The device is already in DFU; no shutdown or button sequence is needed. Its installed OS, battery and pairing state cannot be read here, so confirm it has sufficient charge. After authorization, a temporary ramdisk will read the installed system and require iOS 6.1.6 (10B500) without an existing jailbreak before installation. This does not upgrade or restore other versions to 6.1.6. Verification after reboot requires working pairing.

batteryAbove50.title: Battery at 50% or more
batteryAbove50.detail: The device reboots several times. A low battery can shut it down mid-flow.

workingButtons.title: Power and Home buttons work
workingButtons.detail: Entering DFU requires the Power and Home buttons. Check that both buttons work before starting.

backupCompleted.title: Device data is backed up
backupCompleted.detail: Recovery can erase data. Make an independent backup before real operations.

stableCable.title: Reliable cable, directly into the computer
stableCable.detail: Avoid hubs and extension cables. Any disconnect interrupts the flow.

computerAwake.title: The computer will not sleep or lock
computerAwake.detail: Disable automatic sleep for now. Sleep drops the USB connection.

dfu.autoAdvance: The flow continues automatically once DFU mode is detected.
dfu.safeToCancel: Nothing has been written yet. Cancelling here is safe.

idle.title: Completely power off the device first
idle.body: Keep USB connected, shut the device down completely and wait for the screen to go dark. When ready, start the guide and hold Power and Home for 10 seconds, then release Power and keep holding Home for 8 seconds.

holdBoth.title: Hold Power + Home
holdBoth.body: Hold the top Power button and Home together for 10 seconds, until the countdown ends.

holdHome.title: Release Power, keep holding Home
holdHome.body: Release only Power. Keep holding Home for 8 seconds, until the countdown ends.

detecting.title: You can let go. Detecting…
detecting.body: The screen should stay black. Pocket Studio is waiting for the device to reappear in DFU mode.

timeout.title: DFU mode was not detected
timeout.body: Power the device off completely again, keep USB connected and retry the 10-second then 8-second button sequence.

summary.plug: Keep USB connected and completely power off the device first.
summary.holdBoth: Hold Power and Home together for {seconds} seconds.
summary.releasePower: Release Power, keep holding Home for 8 seconds.
summary.blackScreen: DFU keeps the display black, but success must be confirmed by device detection.

appleLogo.title: An Apple logo appeared:
appleLogo.body: Power was held too long or released too late. Let the device finish booting, then start the guide again.

recoveryScreen.title: The "connect to iTunes" screen appeared:
recoveryScreen.body: The device entered Recovery instead of DFU. Hold Power and Home for about 15 seconds to leave it, then try again.

nothing.title: Black screen but nothing detected:
nothing.body: Try another USB port or cable, and avoid hubs.

exitDfu.title: To leave DFU mode:
exitDfu.body: Hold Power and Home for about 15 seconds. The device reboots normally.

execution.cancelHint: The current step can be interrupted safely.
execution.cannotCancelNow: This step cannot be interrupted safely. Please wait.

keepConnected.title: Do not unplug or shut down
keepConnected.body: The device screen goes black and the device reboots a few times. This is expected.
keepConnected.afterPointOfNoReturn: Writing to the device has started. Interrupting now can leave the device unbootable and require a full restore.

mode.auto: Running automatically, keep the cable in

success.title: Device preparation complete
success.body: Jailbreak, SSH and AppSync installation are verified. OpenSSH is enabled; manage the device root and mobile passwords appropriately.

failed.title: The flow failed
failed.body: The flow could not be completed.

cancelled.title: Flow cancelled
cancelled.body: Preparation stopped at a safe checkpoint. Previously completed changes remain; recheck the device state.

result.notRecoverable: An immediate retry is unavailable in this state. Follow the guidance above, then start a new complete flow.
result.recheckHint: Check the current device state before deciding on another preparation run.

preparation.demoNotice: Browser demo: actions here do not modify a physical device.

appSyncInstallFailed.title: AppSync preparation incomplete
appSyncInstallFailed.body: System package installation did not finish. Some packages may already be installed; recheck the device environment.
recovery: Recheck the device and review a new preparation plan.

appSyncDependencies.title: System dependencies need attention
appSyncDependencies.body: The dependency check found conflicts or unmet requirements. No system packages were installed; check the device package manager.
recovery: Recheck the device and review a new preparation plan.

appSyncVerificationFailed.title: AppSync verification incomplete
appSyncVerificationFailed.body: AppSync installation could not be confirmed. Recheck the environment and continue AppSync preparation without repeating the jailbreak.
recovery: Recheck the device and review a new preparation plan.

sshAuthenticationFailed.title: SSH authentication failed
sshAuthenticationFailed.body: The device rejected the root password. Review a new plan and enter the correct password.
recovery: Recheck the device and review a new preparation plan.

appSyncRestartRequired.title: AppSync is installed. Restart your device.
appSyncRestartRequired.body: System packages are verified, but the app installation service could not be restarted. Plugin activation is not yet confirmed.
recovery: Power the device off and on, then recheck after it returns to the Home screen.

startErrors.sshAuthenticationFailed: The SSH password was rejected. Enter the correct password.
startErrors.sshRequired: OpenSSH is required to prepare AppSync separately. Install or enable OpenSSH on the device first.

appSync.explanation: AppSync is a system plugin that allows development IPAs with fakesignatures. Jailbreak alone does not install it. Already jailbroken devices can prepare it separately.
appSync.intro: This device is already jailbroken. This plan prepares AppSync and its dependencies over USB SSH, without DFU or jailbreak steps.
appSync.packages: Install or update these pinned system packages while retaining newer installed versions. Dependencies are checked before installation, without forced overrides. The device UI and installation service may briefly restart.
appSync.passwordHint: Leave empty to use the default from Preferences. The password is used only for this USB SSH connection and never written to logs.
appSync.successBody: AppSync and its dependencies have verified installation records. Try installing an app from the store; if this is the first installation and you have not restarted yet, restart the device first.

disclaimerSections.heading: System package changes
disclaimerSections.body: This operation installs pinned AppSync packages and required dependencies as root, changing how the device validates app signatures.

disclaimerSections.heading: Interruption and recovery
disclaimerSections.body: Package installation cannot be cancelled once writing starts. Completed changes may remain after failure; recheck the environment rather than repeating the jailbreak.

disclaimerSections.heading: Connection and credentials
disclaimerSections.body: The connection is bound to the identified USB device and its SSH host key. The password is used in memory for authentication. Keep power and the connection stable.

appSync.preamble: Read the system changes below. Installation starts only after you choose Agree and start.

interruptionHazard.title: Interrupted installation can leave incomplete packages
interruptionHazard.body: Disconnecting, losing power or closing the app during package writes may require repairing dependencies in the device package manager.
interruptionHazard.mitigation: Keep power and the connection stable, and wait for the installation result.

securityPosture.title: AppSync relaxes app signature checks
securityPosture.body: AppSync permits unsigned or fakesigned development IPAs. Install software you trust and protect the device SSH accounts.
securityPosture.mitigation: Use trusted software sources and protect device passwords.

communityTooling.title: System plugins may have compatibility issues
communityTooling.body: AppSync and its dependencies are community maintained and may conflict with other plugins. Verified package records do not prove successful plugin loading.
communityTooling.mitigation: Back up first and inspect the device package manager if conflicts occur.

appSync.restartInstructions: Manually power your device off and on. Once the Home screen appears, choose “I restarted — recheck”, then try installing an app from the store.
